title: Create a storyboard from your source image using a Custom GPT Image 2.0…
content: Create a storyboard from your source image using a Custom GPT Image 2.0 workflow, then feed that storyboard into Seedance 2.0 to generate the final video.
tips: Create a storyboard from your source image using a Custom GPT Image 2.0 workflow, then feed that storyboard into Seedance 2.0 to generate the final video.
